fields.statement: The conductor's three review checks are plan (compliance + model) and code (the former quality), plus qa. The classic ship-change, the review workflow and docs-review still use the check-compliance, check-model and check-quality topics, and classic must stay unchanged. How should the plan and code checks get their role topics? / In a conductor run there is no checks step, so rhiza run findings --check and rhiza run verdict --check refuse today. How should they know which check names a conductor run accepts? / The conductor default's gate must fail while any blocker or major finding stands (not downgraded or dropped by a critic). Gate steps run commands the daemon owns. How should the gate count standing findings? / The daemon skips accepted change sets with no leaves today. Under the conductor default, the conductor plans the missing leaves. Which leafless change sets should the daemon now pick?
